purpose: 동일한 관세 원고 소재의 스타일 비교 시안

variants.initial_prompt: Create a full-bleed landscape 16:9 background image for an English listening video. Same subject for a visual style comparison: North American cross-border trade facing uncertainty, a freight truck, shipping containers, stacked lumber, plain dairy cartons and unlabelled wine bottles in a cargo terminal. Convey paused trade negotiations conceptually without depicting a complete trade shutdown, economic crash or a specific real incident. No readable words, letters, numbers, prices, graphs, maps, logos, national flags or watermarks. No identifiable politicians. Main objects in center and upper-middle; top 10% and bottom 25% less busy for text to be separately composited. Do not put any title or captions into the image. STYLE: bold modern flat vector editorial graphics with clean geometric silhouettes, crisp hard edges, limited cobalt blue, white, coral red and charcoal palette. Strong asymmetric diagonal composition and clear negative space, a close foreground truck and simplified goods with container blocks behind. No realistic shading, no paper texture, no beige watercolor, no people around a meeting table. Truly two-dimensional graphic shapes, sophisticated adult news illustration.
variants.final_edit_summary: 기존 매체·팔레트·소재를 유지하고 일시정지 버튼, 물음표, 말풍선, 악수 아이콘, 설명용 기호를 제거. 사진풍 시안은 표지판 전체와 트럭 로고·컨테이너 문자도 제거. 실제 물류 설비와 게이트는 유지.
